newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady to lower Wednesday amid lackluster activity, several dealers said.
"We have light demand with light supply in thin trading," a St Louis dealer said.

In the northeast, trading was also slow. "We have had some maybe overbooking for this week on feed that is being delayed into next week and that is just keeping buying interest on the quiet side," a Buffalo dealer said.

"The market is trying to heal up from the holidays," a North Carolina dealer said. He noted the market was a short period away from new crop wheat. "Everybody thinks when we get wheat moving the midds will come down," he said.
